owner_directive: Make Restore the single recovery path: refresh the block registry after restore/merge/cherry-pick, rename Run history's Restore workflow to Restore and give it the full-tree git path, implement the never-built environment drift check and run it before a restore, retire Re-run's remaining user surface, and drop the node toolbar's Restart button which is a byte-identical duplicate of Run. Owner directed one issue covering all of it; keep parent_run_id read paths, remove only user-reachable actions.
